input.description: Current XLSX workbook. Convert legacy XLS before selecting Open XML cells.

sheet.description: Exact current worksheet name returned by workbook observation.

range.description: Explicit native A1 cell or rectangular range. A single cell is a one-cell range.

offset.description: Zero-based cell offset in row-major order within the selected range. Continue only when another selected cell is needed.

limit.description: Maximum selected cells in this bounded page.

returnContent.description: Return this selected technical page directly when it fits the response limit. May be combined with output.

output.description: Optional immutable JSON artifact path for this selected technical page. May be combined with returnContent.
